section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex / Model Grant Agreement / AGA template used as governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, prior experience, figures) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity (including preparatory drafting) before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Audited artifact is a Phase 8 Tier 5 proposal section (schema_id "orch.tier5.excellence_section.v1"), yet docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json has gate_pass_declaration: "fail" with blocking inconsistency BLK-01 ("absent budget artifacts constitute a blocking gate failure, not a hold state"). The drafted section also asserts budget-figure references without a passing gate: "an in-kind contribution of the order of 2.5 person-months from the supervisor and 2.0 person-months from the co-supervisor" and "An in-kind commitment of the order of 3.0 person-months from the placement host". Per CLAUDE.md §13.4 and §8.4 the Phase-8 block is unconditional and instrument-independent until gate_09 passes.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or referencing outputs of a phase higher than the current phase.
Finalising text with incomplete source state without flagging the gap in the deliverable.
Using generic programme knowledge as a substitute for Tier 1 source documents for regulatory claims.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1-4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

decision_log_entry.resolution_note: Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution. A Phase 8 Tier 5 proposal section (excellence_section.json) exists while the Phase 7 budget gate declares gate_pass_declaration: 'fail' (BLK-01).
